verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API that covers "much of the data in the system" (items, occurrences, metrics, deploys), with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and item-listing endpoints. A Terraform provider and an official MCP server add more programmatic access. The vendor's own wording says "much of", not all, and nothing shows that UI features such as custom fingerprinting, merging, notification setup, ownership or retention settings can be managed through the API. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, API coverage of configuration and admin features (grouping rules, merges, notifications, retention), independent corroboration of API completeness.
